Cash spent so far: $9,799.68. Remaining budget: $10,200.32. Buying 16 more shares at 222.72 = $3,563.52, total $13,363.20 — within budget. That satisfies "top up if still short" if we count the 44 filled shares as owned.

If we bought 60 more, that'd be $13,363 additional → total $23,163, exceeding $20,000. So can't do that anyway.

The safest compliant action: buy 16 shares to bring the filled total to 60 shares (44 + 16), staying within budget. Then if positions still don't show, report the discrepancy to the user rather than overbuying.

Let me get a fresh quote and place the top-up of 16 shares.

Actually, should I buy 16 or more? The rule says end with at least 60. Buying 16 gets filled total exactly 60. Going above (e.g., to 60 in reported positions → 104 total) would violate $20k cap. So 16.
